title: Hummus-Like American Falafel Hot-Pot
description: A savory, comforting take on the classic Middle Eastern street food, featuring crispy falafel, rich and creamy sauce, and an exciting twist on traditional falafel hot-pot.

ingredients.name: Tandoor spice mix
ingredients.notes: Make sure to adjust to taste.

instructions: Heat the tandoor spice mix in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Cook the falafel mix according to package instructions and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the Greek yogurt, garlic mayonnaise, and sesame oil. Blend until smooth.
Add the cooked falafel to the blender and blend until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the skillet with the tandoor spice mix and stir until heated through.
Add the chopped parsley, scallions, and red bell pepper to the skillet if using. Stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt as needed.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
If using, sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the top and serve immediately.
Stir in water as needed to achieve the desired consistency.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
